arithmetic: For nonzero zero-based rune index j, compute q=floor(729/j), r=729 mod j, base=q mod 29. Apply +line when 2r>j, -line when 2r<j, and 0 when 2r=j; the literal <0.5 case includes r=0. The source does not specify wrap, so the trace reports both raw and modulo-29 candidate indices. F has j=0 and remains undefined.
line_conventions: Report both a line number continuous across LP2-00–02 and one reset at each page. Rune rows are nonempty text lines. The posted example uses line 1, where both conventions agree.
